column1: # EmuSen's named exceptions to a hosted core's own extensions, one line each, tab-separated: the core's file stem, as libretro-cores.tsv names it; the EmuSen system the exception holds for, one its line names; the extensions EmuSen adds for that system, |-separated without dots, - for none; those it drops, the same way; and the reason, which names the rule that sets it. A core takes a game of a system only when its line names the system and the file ends in one of its .info's supported_extensions, these lines applied (EmuSen_LibretroHost.md §4.1a, 2026-11-01).
# No exception is named yet: every hosted core takes exactly what its .info lists, for each system its line names.
